```{r load csv files}

# load bucket trap data
bucket_trap_data <- curl("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/butterfliesrcool/github_practice/refs/heads/main/inputs/bucket_trap_data.csv")
bug_data <- read.csv(bucket_trap_data, header = TRUE, sep = ",")
head(bug_data)

small <- subset(bug_data, Size %in% c("S"))

write.csv(small,file='/Users/abbyrobinson/Desktop/Owens Lab/github_practice/outputs/small_data.csv', row.names=FALSE)

```
